sites.name: Cayman Chemical
sites.selection: The homepage is a JavaScript app (curl returns a short shell). Headless Chrome rendered the title “Home | Cayman Chemical”. A headless load of https://www.caymanchem.com/search?q=DSPE-PEG rendered the title “31 Results | DSPE-PEG | Search | Cayman Chemical” and included the link /product/28181/dspe-mpeg-2000-sodium-salt. That link is the measured product page. /search.jsp is disallowed and was not requested; /search?q= is a different path.
sites.robots: https://www.caymanchem.com/robots.txt disallows /app/screen/ProductPrintable/, /legacy/ and /search.jsp. AhrefsBot has Crawl-delay: 10. No crawl-delay for *.

sites.name: TCI
sites.selection: https://www.tcichemicals.com/robots.txt and https://www.tcichemicals.com/US/en/ both returned an Akamai “Access Denied” HTML page from this host on 2026-10-22, so a product URL could not be chosen from the live catalogue. The attempted product URL is the TCI link already published on the AMT ranking page for amino-PEG3-OH (https://www.tcichemicals.com/US/en/p/A2420). If Lighthouse only received the denial page, the table says blocked and does not treat those scores as the catalogue.
sites.robots: robots.txt itself was Access Denied (Akamai reference page). No crawl rules could be read. Requests were limited to the Lighthouse runs.

sites.name: Sigma-Aldrich / Merck
sites.selection: Curl discovery from this host did not return a page: HTTP/2 failed with curl error 92 (INTERNAL_ERROR), HTTP/1.1 timed out with 0 bytes, and an early headless Chrome attempt reported net::ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR. The product URL is the Sigma-Aldrich link already published on the AMT ranking page for 4-bromomethylphenyl pinacol boronate (Aldrich 718513). Lighthouse Chrome later received HTTP 200 for the homepage on mobile and desktop, and for this product URL on mobile, three runs each. Desktop Lighthouse on the product URL returned status 403 on all three runs; those runs are marked blocked and are not scored. A separate headless review of the product URL and of path-search URLs received Akamai Access Denied.
sites.robots: A later review fetch of https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/robots.txt succeeded. The excerpt is stored in compare/data/captures/sigma.json under search.robotsExcerpt. It disallows some search and certificate paths. The review still did not request certificate URLs. Path-search URLs used in the review were answered with Akamai Access Denied.
